∀ {F : NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.Profile} {XR : ℝ} {c : ℝ → NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Coeff},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E F XR c) NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.domain →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U F XR) NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.domain →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.H F XR c) NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.domain →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Pi F XR c) NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.domain →
          (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
              ∀ (X : ℝ), 0 < X → 0 < NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E F XR c (X, eta)) →
            NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U F XR = NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.U F XR →
              (∀ (eta X : ℝ), NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.M F XR eta X = NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.M F XR eta X) →
                (∀ (eta X : ℝ),
                    NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.J F XR c eta X = NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.J F XR eta X) →
                  (∀ (eta : ℝ),
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun (X : ℝ) => NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U F XR (X, eta))
                        (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                    (∀ (eta : ℝ),
                        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                          (fun (X : ℝ) =>
                            NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.H F XR c (X, eta) * NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U F XR (X, eta))
                          (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                      (∀ (eta : ℝ), ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U F XR (X, eta) = 0) →
                        (∀ (eta : ℝ),
                            ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0,
                                NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.H F XR c (X, eta) *
                                  NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U F XR (X, eta) =
                              0) →
                          (∀ (eta X : ℝ),
                              0 < X →
                                NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.pulseEndRadius F XR ≤ X →
                                  NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U F XR (X, eta) = 0 ∧
                                    NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.M F XR eta X = 0 ∧
                                      NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.J F XR c eta X = 0) →
                            (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.energyDensity F XR c eta)
                                  (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                              (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                  NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.totalS F XR c eta = 0) →
                                (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                      (fun (X : ℝ) =>
                                        NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.H F XR c (X, eta) -
                                          NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.powerH F XR X)
                                      (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                  (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                      ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0,
                                          NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.H F XR c (X, eta) -
                                            NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.powerH F XR X =
                                        0) →
                                    (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                          (NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.canonicalKernel F XR c eta) (Set.Ioi 0)
                                          MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                      (∀ (eta X : ℝ),
                                          NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Pi F XR c (X, eta) =
                                            -(1 / 2) *
                                              ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Ioi X,
                                                NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E F XR c (u, eta) ^ 2 / u) →
                                        (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                            NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.axisDatum F XR c eta = F.axisDatum eta) →
                                          (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                              Filter.Tendsto
                                                (fun (X : ℝ) => NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Pi F XR c (X, eta))
                                                (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (F.axisDatum eta))) →
                                            (AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (NavierStokes.SchedulePressure.complexAxisPressure F.data)
                                                  NavierStokes.PressureDatum.strip ∧
                                                ∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                                  NavierStokes.SchedulePressure.complexAxisPressure F.data ↑eta =
                                                    ↑(NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.axisDatum F XR c eta)) →
                                              (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                                  ∀ (X : ℝ),
                                                    0 < X →
                                                      X ≤ NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.patchRadius F XR →
                                                        NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E F XR c (X, eta) =
                                                            NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) ∧
                                                          NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Pi F XR c (X, eta) =
                                                            NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.Pi F XR (X, eta)) →
                                                (∀ eta ∈ NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
                                                    ∀ (X : ℝ),
                                                      0 < X →
                                                        X ≤ XR →
                                                          NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E F XR c (X, eta) =
                                                              F.data.core.P * NavierStokes.OutgoingSchedule.shape eta *
                                                                (X / XR) ^ (1 / 10) ∧
                                                            NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U F XR (X, eta) = 4 * eta ∧
                                                              NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Pi F XR c (X, eta) =
                                                                F.axisDatum eta +
                                                                  5 / 2 * F.data.core.P ^ 2 *
                                                                      NavierStokes.OutgoingSchedule.shape eta ^ 2 *
                                                                    (X / XR) ^ (1 / 5)) →
                                                  (∀ (eta X : ℝ),
                                                      NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR ≤ X →
                                                        NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E F XR c (X, eta) =
                                                          NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit F.data
                                                            (NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR) eta X) →
                                                    (∀ (eta X : ℝ),
                                                        0 < X →
                                                          3 ≤
                                                              Real.log
                                                                  (X /
                                                                    NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR) +
                                                                1 / 5 →
                                                            NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E F XR c (X, eta) =
                                                              NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.carrierAmplitude F *
                                                                  NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR ^
                                                                    NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.exponent F.data.h *
                                                                NavierStokes.RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile
                                                                  (1 + F.data.h)
                                                                  (NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.diffusion eta) X) →
                                                      Disjoint
                                                          (Set.Icc (NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.patchRadius F XR)
                                                            (NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.patchRadius F XR *
                                                              NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.compensationPatch.right))
                                                          (Set.Ici (NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR)) →
                                                        NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Specification F XR c
